preceding_agent.bottleneck: A candidate momentum effect may depend on market regime even after horizon robustness.
preceding_agent.next: Preserve frontier-first selection mechanism as documented in LEARNING_STATE.md and RETAIN the frontier decision framework. The volatility-conditioned momentum cell closes as falsified, maintaining the evidence base with durable negative evidence.
preceding_agent.objective: Test one explicitly predeclared past-only volatility gate on lookback-5 momentum through the existing regime-stability and null framework.
preceding_agent.observed_effect: The volatility gate did NOT create a reproducible improvement in robustness for momentum. The momentum edge under volatility conditioning is REGIME_DEPENDENT on GOOGL (edge only in certain regime mix) and REGIME_STABLE on AMZN/JPM/TSLA/MSFT (positive edge in some segments). No asset showed a meaningful improvement beyond the original momentum; the gate fails the success criterion.
preceding_agent.question: Does a single past-only volatility gate create a predeclared robustness improvement for the qualified momentum effect?
preceding_agent.uncertainty_reduced: yes demonstrated: the evidence falsifies the hypothesis that the same conditioning that was falsified on MA crossover would rescue the momentum edge.
preceding_agent.uncertainty_targeted: Whether a past-only volatility classifier can separate the 2009-2013 'good' turbulent regime from the 2022-2026 'bad' turbulent regime in the context of lookback-5 momentum.
